_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the judge returned them; each why is abridged by the run from the judge's report.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 2 and 4 strong, 4 measured right; 7's primitive worker and white yard, 6's thick rod and board flags over a mid sky, 3's cold box and bright trailer doors, 9's pale pasted worker.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world and a motif that changes state; 3 and 8 outside it.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals trace; the document title drops c1's 'in the US'; 'Half the floor' draws two lower bounds on different bases as one US floor, disclosed only on 9; 'Laser chips' universal where c19 says 'our'; labels drop 'approximately'; 'two official records' counts the 10-Q twice.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where; no county, utility, site or deadline.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns it, 2 pays, 7 turns; 8 out of order; 3 and 4 slow the middle.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Third earnings deck; reuses no. 68's world and worker.

one_sentence_fix: Put 'in the US' back into the document title and rewrite frame 5's hook so the pads are the company-wide target rather than the US bay's floor.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive worker, white yard, no jamb, stubs read as bollards.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark jamb across the left third; drop or silhouette the worker; low flush stubs.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Thick rod and board pennants read as a barrier; mid sky with a horizon band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: 3 mm cord, fluttering strips, eye at 0.6 m, fog the band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cold box, white trailer doors, painted stripe clerestory.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Darken the trailer doors, warm the walls, real lit glazing.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Overlit pale worker; truss behind the hook.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Door-side rim only; truss to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey rack faces, tabs as a string of keys, fibre shadows.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop to one switch, steel to near black, fibre into a tray.
